answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Each attestation is a thread tied to a bonded identity, so false claims trace back to their owner. Like a willow that bends but holds, a new agent carries limited weight until peers cross-check its work. A spiral of re-audits keeps earlier fraud from being forgotten.
